name: Rowboats Finnhamn - Ingmarsö
estimatedTime: 2 minutes official one-way crossing; allow substantially more time if the boats need balancing
description: A short but operationally important Stockholm Archipelago Trail transfer where hikers row between the Finnhamn and Ingmarsö sections. The crossing runs between Idholmen on the Finnhamn side and Kålgårdsön on the Ingmarsö side. It should be presented as a seasonal rowboat connector, not as a normal walking section.
utilities: No public toilet, drinking water, shop, cafe, shelter, campsite, lighting, lifebuoy, bench or bin was confirmed as part of the connector itself after iteration 2.

Nearby Finnhamn and Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön amenities should be attached to their respective section records. Länsstyrelsen confirms toilets/fireplaces on Finnhamn generally, and SAT Finnhamn step-by-step confirms Pojkarnas Udde barbecue spots, but this does not make them connector facilities.
The rowboats are transport infrastructure, not rental boats or a leisure-excursion facility.
No official source confirmed lifejackets/PFDs, bailers or emergency equipment at the boats; do not imply they are provided.
waterSources: No drinking water source was confirmed at either rowboat landing.
Carry water from confirmed points on Finnhamn or Ingmarsö rather than relying on the connector.
notes: Route shape: point-to-point water connector between the Finnhamn and Ingmarsö SAT sections.
Always leave one rowboat on each side. A solo party may need to row across, tow the opposite boat back, leave one boat at the start side, and row across again.
Pull the boat onto land, tie it securely, turn it upside down and secure the oars after use.
Do not overload the boat and do not use it for private excursions.
Avoid the crossing in darkness, strong wind, poor visibility, thunder, ice, cold-water risk or if the boat, oars or rope are damaged.
No official source confirms lifejackets/PFDs are provided; bring or wear your own PFD if needed.

Plan the crossing in daylight; treat the landings as unlit and without verified rescue equipment or shelter. Use OSM negative tags to suppress false facility icons rather than as detailed user-facing facts.

Practical reports say the Finnhamn/Idholmen side can be harder to find and that boats may contain rainwater, so use the official SAT map/GPX near western Idholmen and allow time to empty the boat if needed.
If a rowboat is missing, damaged, unsafe, or the landing is blocked, do not cross. Use SAT/Skärgårdsstiftelsen reporting for non-urgent issues; call 112 only for urgent danger.
Official SAT notes that the Ingmarsö track on Kålgårdsön was updated in July 2025 and differs from Båtluffarleden, so do not assume all older Båtluffarleden descriptions exactly match SAT.
